name: difference-plot
title: Difference plot
description: Position size against percentage difference on a compressed vertical scale, with a tolerance corridor and rails for one-sided records.

text.title: {left} against {right}
text.lede: Every {unitOne} is one dot: how big it is, left to right, and how far {rightShort} sits from {leftShort}, up or down. Dots inside the corridor agree within tolerance.
text.chartSub: Tolerance is {tolerance}. The vertical scale is compressed away from zero.
text.railsNote: Rails below: {unit} on one side only
text.noCompare: Nothing to compare on the other side

options.name: yCap
options.description: Maximum percentage difference shown before compression capping.

options.name: labelTop
options.description: Number of largest breaks to label directly on the chart.
